title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.99
summary: AAC-Ton wird in HLS-TS-Segmenten auch bei doppelten FFprobe-Codeczeilen korrekt erkannt.
changes: Recognize AAC even when MPEG-TS ffprobe reports codec_name twice
Avoid falsely marking verified AAC as missing and auto-disabling the user audio session
Add one info event LOCAL_HLS_AUDIO_VERIFIED when completed HLS segments contain AAC
Regression tests for duplicate AAC lines, negative codecs, and callsite integration
Preserve stable single live player, AV muxing, go2rtc broker, recordings and PHP portal
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.99
description: Fix false-negative AAC verification in local HLS segment probing
releaseNotes: Upgrade camera server to 2.20.99. On a camera known to have G.711 audio, request audio and check LOCAL_HLS_AUDIO_VERIFIED, then tap again to unmute. This fixes a known ffprobe false-negative; RTSP/network issues may still occur. PHP 3.1.1 does not change.
